title: Llama wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sky' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#2b1b4d'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1a1030'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#f6e2c0'/>

  <circle cx='34' cy='64' r='8' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='64' r='8' fill='#fff4dd'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='9' fill='#fff4dd'/>

  <rect x='34' y='84' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#e8cf a8'/>

  <rect x='59' y='84' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#e8cfa8'/>

  <path d='M44 62 Q42 44 46 34 L58 34 Q62 44 58 62 Z' fill='#f6e2c0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='28' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#fff4dd'/>

  <ellipse cx='64' cy='15' rx='4' ry='8' fill='#f6e2c0' transform='rotate(20 64 15)'/>

  <ellipse cx='56' cy='33' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#7a3b2e'/>
  <path d='M49 38 Q52 40 55 38' stroke='#7a3b2e' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#3ad6c8'/>
  <rect x='54' y='22' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#3ad6c8'/>
  <rect x='49' y='24' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#3ad6c8'/>
  <rect x='39' y='23' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a8fff6'/>
  <rect x='55' y='23' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a8fff6'/>
